lines.text: Anyone lacking wisdom should ask God in faith, but the doubter is like a reed shaken by the wind.

wrong_details.wrong: a reed shaken by the wind
wrong_details.true: a wave of the sea, blown and tossed by the wind

lines.text: The humble brother exults in his high position, and the rich man in his low position, like a fading flower.
The man who perseveres under trial will receive the crown of glory promised to those who love God.
God tempts no one, but each person's own desire gives birth to sin, and full-grown sin gives birth to death.
